# Brochure Plan

Use this after the website direction is stable and before generating the brochure.

## Goal

Describe the purpose of the brochure and how it relates to the site.

## Core Inputs

- approved website copy
- finalised design system
- confirmed contact details
- selected imagery
- service summaries
- fees

## Panel Strategy

Note what should appear on each panel and why.

## Copy Rules

- use British English
- do not use em dashes
- keep service descriptions fuller than homepage summaries
- make panels feel visually full

## Image Rules

- one image per service card
- use meaningful ceremony imagery
- avoid decorative clutter that weakens print output

## Print-Safe Rules

Note any styling restrictions needed for clean import into vector editors.

## Final Checklist

List the brochure-specific review checks before export.
